newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish Treasury to auction loans up to 1 tln pta.
newsitem.headline: Spanish Treasury to auction loans up to 1 tln pta.

text.p: Spanish Treasury said on Friday it would borrow up to one trillion pesetas from financial entities and would then auction these loans.
In a statement the Treasury said the official state bulletin authorised the auction on Thursday, which will start today and will end on July 17.
The Treasury added that these loans will be usable through the issue of Treasury bills.
"On the same day as the transaction starts, the Treasury will deliver to bank (or banks) Treasury bills for the same amount of the loan, and with the same maturity," the statement said.
For each credit line, maturities will range from a minimum of 15 days to a maximum of three months.
Offers can be presented by all financial entities with an account at the clearing house (centrales de anotaciones).
Offers can be individual or syndicated, with a minimum tranche of 250 billion pesetas.
Offers have to specify interest rates in relation to maturity, opening fees, and eventual commission fees.
The notice period will be 48 hours for withdrawal below 50 percent of the loan, and 72 hours for withdrawals equal to or above 50 percent of the loan.
The deadline for presenting offers is 1200 GMT on July 17.
